Cookie Policy

How browser storage supports website navigation, signup, chat and checkout.

Last updated: 13 November 2026

This Cookie Policy explains cookies and similar browser storage used in connection with www.ayudagrow.com, operated by Ayuda Grow LLC. Read it alongside our Privacy Policy, which explains personal information, retention and your rights.

What cookies and browser storage do

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. They can help a service recognise a browser, maintain a session or remember preferences. Session storage and local storage also hold information in your browser. Session storage normally lasts for a tab session, while local storage can remain after you close the browser. Browser session-restoration settings can affect how long session information remains available.

Some storage is set by the website you visit. Other storage is set by providers whose forms, chat or payment services you use. A provider's general cookie policy can describe services beyond those used on AyudaGrow.

Website navigation storage

AyudaGrow uses the session-storage entry ayudaVisits:clean-v1 to remember page routes, scroll position and selected interface controls. This helps the Back and Forward buttons return you to your previous place. It holds up to 100 saved visit entries in the browser session. Clearing site data removes the saved navigation state.

Signup forms and AI chat

Our signup forms and AI chat are provided through HighLevel. These embedded services may use cookies, local or session storage and technical connection information to maintain their sessions and operate the forms and conversations. Information you submit is handled as described in our Privacy Policy.

Storage set by embedded providers has its own lifetimes and controls. Our 12-month chat-transcript retention period concerns conversation records; it is not a claim that every chat cookie lasts 12 months. HighLevel describes its wider use of these technologies in its Cookie Policy.

Stripe checkout

When you continue to Stripe checkout, Stripe uses cookies and similar technologies for payment functionality, security and fraud prevention. Its services can also use functional or other storage depending on the service and choices available. See Stripe's Cookie Policy for purposes, durations and available controls.

Analytics and advertising

We do not deploy Google Analytics 4 or Meta advertising tags on this website. This does not mean our embedded providers operate without cookies or technical data collection. If we introduce analytics or advertising tools, we will update this policy and provide consent controls where required.

Your choices

You can use your browser's privacy settings to inspect, block or delete cookies and clear site data, including local and session storage. Settings may need to be changed separately for each browser, device and provider domain. Use any privacy controls offered by the provider when using its service.

Blocking or deleting storage can reset saved page positions and selections, interrupt chat sessions or affect signup and checkout. Browser settings do not delete records already submitted to AyudaGrow or its service providers. To request access to or deletion of personal information, contact us using the details below.

Changes and contact

We update this page when our use of these technologies changes and revise the last-updated date.
